ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: AE number
Did this participant experience an adverse event?
Name of adverse event:
Adverse event start date:
Notes: MM/DD/YYYY. Date is shifted relative to an anchoring event

ElementDescription: Adverse event ongoing?
Adverse event stop date:
Notes: MM/DD/YYYY. Date is shifted relative to an anchoring event

ElementDescription: Severity:
Notes: 1 = MILD-event  does  not  generally  interfere  with  usual  daily  activities  and/or  does not require medical care; 2 = MODERATE-event  interferes  with  usual  daily  activities  and/or  requires  self-medical care or outpatient medical care; 3 = SEVERE-event interrupts usual daily activities and/or requires inpatient medical care or medical care with overnight stay in hospital observation service

ElementDescription: Action taken: (Select all that apply) (choice=No action taken)

Action taken: (Select all that apply) (choice=Other)
If other action taken, specify:
Modification to study treatment:
Notes: 1 = No modification to study treatment; 2 = Discontinued permanently; 3 = Discontinued temporarily; 4 = Delayed

ElementDescription: Adverse event outcome:
Notes: 1 = Recovered  (returned to baseline); 2 = Recovered with sequelae; 3 = Symptom(s) persist; 4 = Death

ElementDescription: Relationship to study intervention:
Notes: 1 = Definitely related; 2 = Probably or possibly related; 3 = Probably not related; 4 = Definitely not related; 5 = Uncertain relationship
